We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 6 reactions, using templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied first four templates, got products (precursors) at each step. Need to continue with template 1914399 then 74054 to reach final target. Also need to ensure each step matches the template (check). We have to construct JSON tree: root molecule is target SMILES given. Then child reaction with template 20810 leading to two precursors (the result from apply_template). The result from apply_template gave a tuple of two SMILES: ('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1', 'O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F'). So those are precursors.

We need to continue retrosynthesis on each precursor using next templates in order. The order must be as given across the whole route? Likely sequential: first reaction uses 20810, then each subsequent reaction uses next template on one of the resulting molecules, maybe branching. We need at least 6 reactions total, using each template once in order. So we need to apply 2895 to one of the precursors from step1 (likely the larger one). We did that: applied to first precursor gave new precursor (with nitro). That step used 2895. Then applied 1914397 to that product gave two precursors: ('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1', 'O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2'). Good.

Now need to apply 1914398 to appropriate precursor (the second one). We applied to that and got ('BrBr', 'O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2'). So that yields BrBr (bromine?) and a similar aromatic ring.

Now need to apply 1914399 to one of the precursors from previous step (maybe the aromatic one). We need to see what 1914399 does. We don't know its transformation. We can try to apply to the aromatic precursor 'O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2' with template 1914399. Let's attempt.
